column2: [intro]
In a world of reels and film frames,
A cinephile within me roams the lanes.
Dark theaters are my playground so true,
Where movies roll and carry me away from the blues.
I'm a cinephile, it’s my deep delight,
Laughing and crying through each film’s might.
Actors and scripts cast their charm,
Cinema’s a never-ending party, so warm.
I settle in with popcorn in hand,
The lights go down, the screen's so grand.
From Chaplin’s laughter to Stallone’s thrill,
I live a thousand lives and crave more still.
